commonAllArms: same strengthened finite boundary oracle and pinned dependency fixtures

latencyBoundary: Fetch-to-consumed-stream time includes provider/gateway/transport and client processing/backpressure. First-read/EOF/error/cancellation are separate; tool overlaps use interval unions. No eager reads, request rewrite or archived body/header/error text.
historicalBoundary: All old outcomes and resources unchanged; sensitivity diagnostics are separate, use public hash-verified input archives, and never repair a submitted patch.
nullOpportunities: No seeded journal, mandatory tool choice, extra retries or replacement when provenance feedback has no exposure.
criteria: Audited success precedes resources. Actual forwarded receipt and exact same-source rerun establish exposure/chronology, never mediation or truthful prose. Every final claim still requires manual audit.
